units.title: Actual product reference measure
units.classification: Shared sphere-calculus support interface; definitions are not theorem credit
units.statement: Write \(E_n=\mathbb R^{n+1}\), \(S_n=\{x\in E_n:\|x\|=1\}\), and \(M_{n,N}=S_n^{\operatorname{Fin}N}\). The dimensions are natural numbers and may be zero. Write \(\tau_n=\operatorname{vol}_{E_n}.\mathrm{toSphere}\), \(\sigma_n=\tau_n(S_n)^{-1}\tau_n\), and \(\mu_{n,N}=\bigotimes_i\sigma_n\); measure scaling uses the extended nonnegative-real inverse. Take Measure.pi over the finite coordinate family of normalized sphere measures. The separately proved probability instance includes the empty product.
assumptions: Use the indicated canonical real Euclidean, unit-sphere and finite-product carriers; no positive-dimension restriction is imposed.
This is a definition or abbreviation. It imposes no unstated regularity, tangency, integrability or probability hypothesis.

steps.lean:
noncomputable def sphereProductMeasure (n N : ℕ) :
    Measure (SphereConfiguration n N) :=
  Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => sphereUniformMeasure n)
